status: PARTIAL VERIFIED: CPU5 native I/D Cache integration

adapter.scope: I/D cache adapter: unchanged legacy independent cache models, four masks, simultaneous ports, native bypass, write-through, all refill faults, reset ledgers

control.scope: ID/EX core through real Dcache adapter: killed refill drain, FENCE, each refill-beat precise error, reset, STORE/WB/IRQ; BP0/1 real CPU5 IF adapter+Icache stale errors, same-edge redirect, precise fault packet, ID backpressure

program.reachability_limit: Top has no external flush: issued LOAD becomes live MEM atomically and masks IRQ, so killed-D drain waiting is tested by the direct-core control suite, not claimed here.
program.scope: CPU5 cached native memory: real IF, RAM byte/halfword writes, independent tags/refills/write-through and complete backend memory; representative FENCE words, devices, IRQ/MRET and FENCE.I illegal
program.termination: Exactly one terminal JALR; bounded already-accepted cold self-JAL tail; shared reset cancels at most one accepted cache-front I request after backend accepted transactions close. Snapshot counters/GPR/RAM precede reset.
